Loading the data, packages 

```{r}
library(multiverse)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(lmerTest)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
install.packages("broom")
library(broom)
library(lme4)
library(knitr)

raw_data = read_csv("data/edge1.1.csv")
# TODO: "Warning: One or more parsing issues, call `problems()` on your data frame for details, e.g.:
  # dat <- vroom(...)
  # problems(dat)"

game = multiverse()


particip_data_duplicates = raw_data %>%  
  dplyr::select(!Order:Number.Characters)|> 
  group_by(ThreadId, Id) %>%
  summarize(across(Type:ContributionsbyAuthor,  ~ paste(unique(.x), collapse = "; "))) 
        
 particip_data_filt = particip_data_duplicates %>% 
  filter(if_any(Type:ContributionsbyAuthor, ~ grepl(";", .x)))
 
 raw_data = anti_join(raw_data, particip_data_filt,  by = c("ThreadId", "Id"))
 
 raw_data = raw_data %>%  
  mutate(percent_by_author = ContributionsbyAuthor/ DebateSize, .after = ContributionsbyAuthor)
 
 particip_data_clean = raw_data %>%  
  dplyr::select(!Order:Number.Characters) %>%  
  group_by(ThreadId, Id) %>%
  summarize(across(Type:ContributionsbyAuthor, unique))

raw_data_n = raw_data %>%  
  group_by(across(c(ThreadId, Id))) %>%  
  dplyr::select(!Live) %>% 
  summarise(across(Type:UniqueFemaleParticipation, unique))

raw_data_n = raw_data %>%  
  dplyr::select(!Live) %>%  
  group_by(across(ThreadId)) %>%  
  summarise(across(Type:UniqueFemaleParticipation, unique))
```

#' ===================================================================
#' NODE 1: data_filtering 
#' @params: (parameters(game)): 
#' $level[[1]]: participant, $level[[2]]: conversation

```{multiverse default-m-1, inside = game}
data_st1 = raw_data %>%  
  dplyr::select(branch(level, 
                       "participant" ~ !c(Order:Number.Characters), 
                       "conversation" ~ !Live )) |> 
  group_by(across(branch(level,
                         "participant" ~ c(ThreadId, Id),
                         "conversation" ~ ThreadId))) |> 
  summarise(branch(level,
                   "participant" ~ across(Type:percent_by_author, unique),
                   "conversation" ~ across(Type:UniqueFemaleParticipation, unique)))

parameters(game)
```
```{r}
# TODO: solve summarise() regroup warning -> output grouped by ThreadId, summaries grouped by ThreadId and Id
```


#' ===================================================================
#' NODE 2: Selecting relevant variables (for analysis)
#' 11 branching points => n(universes) = 11

```{multiverse default-m-2, inside = game}
data_variables = data_st1 %>%  
  select(branch(dv_iv,
    "ContributionsbyAuthor_UniqueFemaleContributors" %when% (level == "participant") ~
      c(ThreadId, Id, Type, ContributionsbyAuthor, UniqueFemaleContributors, UniqueMaleContributors),
    "ContributionsbyAuthor_UniqueFemaleParticipation" %when% (level == "participant") ~
      c(ThreadId, Id, Type, ContributionsbyAuthor, UniqueFemaleParticipation, UniqueFemaleContributors, UniqueMaleContributors),
    "ContributionsbyAuthor_FemaleContributions" %when% (level == "participant") ~
      c(ThreadId, Id, Type, ContributionsbyAuthor, Female_Contributions, UniqueFemaleContributors, UniqueMaleContributors),

    "percent_by_author_UniqueFemaleContributors" %when% (level == "participant") ~
      c(ThreadId, Id, Type, percent_by_author, UniqueFemaleContributors, UniqueMaleContributors),
    "percent_by_author_UniqueFemaleParticipation" %when% (level == "participant") ~
      c(ThreadId, Id, Type, percent_by_author, UniqueFemaleParticipation, UniqueFemaleContributors, UniqueMaleContributors),
    "percent_by_author_FemaleContributions" %when% (level == "participant") ~
      c(ThreadId, Id, Type, percent_by_author, Female_Contributions, UniqueFemaleContributors, UniqueMaleContributors),

    "FemaleParticipation_UniqueFemaleContributors" %when% (level == "conversation") ~
      c(ThreadId, Type, FemaleParticipation, UniqueFemaleContributors, UniqueMaleContributors),
    "FemaleParticipation_UniqueFemaleParticipation" %when% (level == "conversation") ~
      c(ThreadId, Type, FemaleParticipation, UniqueFemaleParticipation, UniqueFemaleContributors, UniqueMaleContributors),
    "FemaleParticipation_FemaleContributions" %when% (level == "conversation") ~
      c(ThreadId, Type, FemaleParticipation, Female_Contributions, UniqueFemaleContributors, UniqueMaleContributors),

    "FemaleContributions_UniqueFemaleContributors" %when% (level == "conversation") ~
      c(ThreadId, Type, Female_Contributions, UniqueFemaleContributors, UniqueMaleContributors),
    "FemaleContributions_UniqueFemaleParticipation" %when% (level == "conversation") ~
      c(ThreadId, Type, Female_Contributions, UniqueFemaleParticipation, UniqueFemaleContributors, UniqueMaleContributors)))
```

#' ===================================================================
#' NODE 3: Filtering => numbers of females in noth levels
#' n(universes = 22)

```{multiverse default-m-3, inside = game}
data_filtered = data_variables %>%  
  filter(branch(n_female_male, 
                "only_female" ~ UniqueFemaleContributors >= 1, 
                "female_and_male" ~ UniqueFemaleContributors >= 1 & UniqueMaleContributors >= 1))
```

#' ===================================================================
#' NODE 4: Filtering: including only comments, or questions and comments. 
#' n(universes) = 44

```{multiverse default-m-4, inside = game}
data_filtered2 <- data_filtered %>%  
  filter(branch(questions, 
                "questions_and_comments" ~ Type == Type, 
                "only_comments" ~ Type == 2))
```

#' Data frame for all 44 possible universes

```{r}
df_expand = multiverse::expand(game)
```

#' Execute multiverse, storing results

```{r}
execute_multiverse(game, progress = TRUE)

results_n4 = extract_variables(game, data_filtered2)

nine <- results_n4$data_filtered2[[9]]     # df from the 9th universe
```

#' ===================================================================
#' NODE 5: PLOTS

```{r}
# plots should be a column in results_n4: a function takes each row, extracts each universe one by one, then creates a df with only the dv and the iv
# then: plots dv (and iv), and the relationship between dv and iv
# also: the plots should be saved into lists 
```


```{r}
install.packages("stringr")
library(stringr)
library(scales)

plots <- vector("list", nrow(results_n4))
dv_plots <- vector("list", nrow(results_n4))
iv_plots <- vector("list", nrow(results_n4))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(results_n4))) {
  
  x <- results_n4$dv_iv[[i]]

  # dealing with underscores
  if (str_starts(x, "percent")) {
  dv <- "percent_by_author"
  iv <- str_remove(x, "^percent_by_author_")
    } else {
      dv <- str_extract(x, "^[^_]+")    
      iv <- str_remove(x, "^[^_]+_")
    }
  iv <- if_else(iv == "FemaleContributions", "Female_Contributions", iv)
  dv <- if_else(dv == "FemaleContributions", "Female_Contributions", dv)

  df <- results_n4$data_filtered2[[i]] %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(all_of(c(dv, iv)))

  plots[[i]] <- ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[iv]], y = .data[[dv]])) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = iv, 
         y = dv,
         title = "Relationship between the dependent and independent variable",
         subtitle = paste("Universe", results_n4$.universe[[i]]))
  
  # dynamic scaling for y axis
  x <- df[[dv]]
  rng <- diff(range(x, na.rm = TRUE))
  n_bins <- 60
  bw <- rng / 60                                 
  
  max_stack <- max(table(floor((x - min(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / bw)))   
  aspect <- 2                                   
  ds <- min(1, 0.8 * n_bins / (max_stack * aspect))
  
  dv_plots[[i]] <- ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[dv]])) +
    geom_dotplot(binwidth = bw, dotsize = ds, method = "histodot", stackratio = 1) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = dv, y = NULL,
         title = paste("Distribution of", dv),
         subtitle = paste("Universe", results_n4$.universe[[i]]))
  
  iv_plots[[i]] <- ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[iv]])) +
    geom_dotplot(binwidth = bw, dotsize = ds, method = "histodot", stackratio = 1) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = iv, y = NULL,
         title = paste("Distribution of", iv),
         subtitle = paste("Universe", results_n4$.universe[[i]]))
  
  print(plots[[i]])
    
}

plots[[8]]
dv_plots[[20]] # universe 8. yayy, plot looks amazing

results_n5 <- results_n4 %>% 
  mutate(dv_iv_plots = plots, 
         dv_plots = dv_plots, 
         iv_plots = iv_plots) 
```

```{r}
  if (str_starts(x, "percent")) {

    } else {
```

## step 1: trycatch error function (?) for one universe in which the Poissoon regression is not applicable
```{r}
# -> then step 1.5 - apply it to the whole analytical space
poisson_fit <- sapply(eighteen, function(x) {
  
  x <- results_n5$dv_iv[[18]]

  if (str_starts(x, "percent")) {
    dv <- "percent_by_author"
    iv <- str_remove(x, "^percent_by_author_")
      } else {
        dv <- str_extract(x, "^[^_]+")    
        iv <- str_remove(x, "^[^_]+_")
      }
  iv <- if_else(iv == "FemaleContributions", "Female_Contributions", iv)
  dv <- if_else(dv == "FemaleContributions", "Female_Contributions", dv)
  
  poisson_data18 <- eighteen %>% 
    ungroup()
  
  # flag where: dv < 1 | iv < 1
  
  tryCatch(
    {
      poisson_model <- glm(dv ~ iv, family = "poisson", data = poisson_data18)
    }, error = function(msg){
      message(paste("Error for Universe 18: ", dv, "is not a non-negative integer count."))
    }
  )
})

poisson_fit
```
